Actual Phase 15-7 measurement execution (human authorized only)

Phase 19-7 final verification report generation on actual records
Phase 19-8 dual-gate unlock judgment on actual measurement results
Only then: app/tests implementation if DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED

authorization_conditions: Phase 15-7 actual measurement executed with integrated_decision=GO

Human authority approval for implementation launch
